record.paper_title: Open Questions in Charm Decays Deserving an Answer
record.original_question: What are the lifetimes of the charm-strange baryons Xi_c^0 and Xi_c^+, and ideally also Omega_c, with enough precision—about 10% for Xi_c^0,+ and around 5% for Omega_c—to test the 1/m_c expansion for charm-baryon decays, constrain higher-order terms not yet computed, and support meaningful extrapolations to beauty-baryon lifetimes?

evidence.quote: Present data on the lifetimes of Ξ0,+ c baryons clearly leave something to be desired. A 10% accuracy on τ (Ξ0,+ c ) represents an appropriate goal; a similar measurement of τ (Ωc) would be neat. Such data would provide us with valuable cross checks of the 1/mc expansion for baryon decays, yield indirect information on terms of higher order in 1/mc not yet computed, and allow us to make numerically meaningful extrapolations to beauty baryon lifetimes.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $\Xi_c^+$, $\Xi_c^0$, and $\Omega_c^0$ denote the lowest-lying charmed-strange baryons (with quark content $usc$, $dsc$, and $ssc$, respectively). Determine the mean proper lifetimes $\tau(\Xi_c^+)$, $\tau(\Xi_c^0)$, and $\tau(\Omega_c^0)$ with experimental precision of approximately $10\%$ or better for $\tau(\Xi_c^{0,+})$ and approximately $5\%$ or better for $\tau(\Omega_c^0)$. The goal of this level of precision is to (i) provide quantitative tests of the heavy-quark $1/m_c$ expansion as applied to inclusive nonleptonic decay widths of charmed baryons, (ii) constrain numerically the size of higher-order terms in the $1/m_c$ expansion that have not been computed from first principles, and (iii) enable reliable numerical extrapolations of these results to predict the lifetimes of the analogous beauty baryons (e.g., $\Xi_b^{0,-}$ and $\Omega_b^-$).
artifact.status_search_result: Modern measurements, particularly from LHCb using prompt charm production at 13 TeV, have achieved the targeted precisions. PDG 2024 lists $\tau(\Xi_c^0) \approx 148.0 \pm 2.3 \pm 2.2$ fs (well under 10%) and $\tau(\Omega_c^0) \approx 276.5 \pm 13.4 \pm 4.4$ fs (~5% precision), with $\tau(\Xi_c^+)$ also measured at the few-percent level. These measurements have substantially altered the picture of the charm-baryon lifetime hierarchy and are routinely used to test the $1/m_c$ HQE.

status_evidence.title: Measurement of the lifetimes of promptly produced Omega_c^0 and Xi_c^0 baryons (LHCb)
status_evidence.snippet: Omega_c^0 lifetime measured to be 276.5 ± 13.4 ± 4.4 ± 0.7 fs; Xi_c^0 lifetime measured to be 148.0 ± 2.3 ± 2.2 ± 0.2 fs.
status_evidence.claim: Targeted ~5% (Omega_c) and ~10% (Xi_c^0) precision has been achieved.

status_evidence.title: PDG 2024 Baryons Summary Tables
status_evidence.snippet: Particle Data Group 2024 listings of charmed-baryon properties including Xi_c^+, Xi_c^0, Omega_c^0 lifetimes.
status_evidence.claim: Current world averages reflect precise charmed-baryon lifetime measurements.
